item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena places a bar magnet on one side of a thin glass sheet and a steel paper clip on the other side, close to the sheet but not touching the magnet.
What will happen to the paper clip?

options.A: It will not move, because the glass sheet blocks the magnetic effect.
options.B: It will move towards the magnet, because the magnetic effect passes through the glass sheet.
options.C: It will move only if the magnet first touches the glass sheet.
options.D: It will not move, because paper clips are never attracted to magnets.
